title: NCAA: Chiefs victorious in Season 102 debut, breeze past Golden Stags
summary: Arellano University opened its NCAA Season 102 campaign with a convincing victory, breezing past San Sebastian College in their Monday afternoon clash at the FilOil Centre in San Juan.
